My name is Jack. I'm 10 years old and I live in Edinburgh with my mum, dad and two brothers. In my free time I like playing the guitar and drawing pictures. I also have a parrot. What about you?
Bye for now,
Jack
qs.question: Which sentence is TRUE according to the e-mail?

options.D: Jack lives with his mum, dad and two brothers.
